_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Does the C# in this Unity project compile? The editor is open, so don't close it.
Run the level importer in batch mode without opening Unity and tell me if it worked.

expectations: the unity-agent-headless skill is not invoked (unity-agent-packages' job)

evals.prompt: Write a unit test for the ScoreCalculator rounding rule.
expectations: the unity-agent-headless skill is not invoked (plain coding task; the repo's test project)

evals.prompt: Compile-check this Unity project without opening the editor.
expectations: the driver ran with -Action compile (or dotnet build on Assembly-CSharp.csproj), proven by the tool call
evals.baseline: 2026-09-06: without the skill a fresh session hit 'No .NET SDKs were found', searched the Unity install for 2 minutes, found Data\DotNetSdk on the 4th try and built the csproj (0 errors); with the skill it was one driver call. Evidence tightened to the driver or its log so the case is not redundant on a machine where the bundled SDK is discoverable.

evals.prompt: Where does Unity 6 write the editor log for this project, and what line tells me a batchmode run succeeded?
expectations: the reply names <project>/Logs/Editor.log (per project) and 'Exiting batchmode successfully'
the reply warns that the exit code alone is not proof and names 'error CS' / 'Scripts have compiler errors'
